Western sanctions against the countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) are backfiring , the organization’s Secretary General Sergey Lebedev said in an interview with TASS Director General Andrey Kondrashov, timed to coincide with the 35th anniversary of the CIS. Lebedev acknowledged that Western sanctions are creating certain difficulties for the CIS member states. “Nevertheless, these actions by the West are leading to a backlash. I would say that resistance to these actions has grown quite strongly across the CIS. There is a desire to prove that we can cooperate and develop our national economies regardless of Western pressure,” he noted.
